headline: Palace Issues MC 131: In-Person Classes Suspended, Alternative Government Work Set in NCR and 17 Provinces
seoTitle: MC 131: Classes, Government Work Setup Aug. 20 | FMB News
seoDescription: Malacañang issued Memorandum Circular No. 131 covering NCR and 17 Luzon provinces for Thursday, August 20, with distance learning and alternative government work arrangements.
deck: The approved FMB News overnight brief reports that Malacañang formalized Thursday's distance-learning and alternative-work arrangements across Metro Manila and 17 Luzon provinces.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: Malacañang issued Memorandum Circular No. 131 for Thursday, August 20, directing the suspension of in-person classes and the use of alternative work arrangements in executive government offices across the National Capital Region and 17 Luzon provinces, according to the approved FMB News overnight package.

The covered provinces are Abra, Bataan, Batangas, Benguet, Bulacan, Cavite, Ilocos Norte, Ilocos Sur, Laguna, La Union, Nueva Ecija, Occidental Mindoro, Oriental Mindoro, Pampanga, Pangasinan, Rizal, Tarlac and Zambales.

sections.heading: Context · What the order means
paragraphs: Schools in the covered areas are directed to use alternative delivery modes, while executive government offices shift to alternative work arrangements. Emergency, disaster-response, health, law-enforcement, firefighting and other essential services remain operational on site.
Private employers are encouraged to use flexible arrangements based on local safety conditions.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: The directive affects students, families, commuters and government workers across a large part of Luzon after successive days of monsoon-related disruption.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Further work and class advisories will depend on weather conditions and subsequent national or local government announcements.
